einzeiler: Week 7 waiver wire targets, rookie wide receiver standouts, and major injury updates.
kurzfassung: This episode covers major injuries to star players like Terry McLaurin and provides comprehensive waiver wire recommendations for Week 7. The hosts also break down streaming options at quarterback and tight end, alongside listener mailbag questions. Key rookie wide receiver performances and potential trade impacts are thoroughly analyzed.
stichpunkte: Terry McLaurin suffers a catastrophic, likely season-ending non-contact knee injury.
Devante Adams is sidelined for 6 to 10 weeks due to a hamstring injury.
Christian McCaffrey manages a heavy workload of 16 carries and 10 targets in a 49ers victory.
Waiver wire analysis highlights top running back and wide receiver targets, including Jordan Mason and Jeremy Bernard.
Rookie wide receivers like Jeremy Bernard and Jacoby Lane emerge as priority waiver additions.
Streaming options at quarterback focus on Kyler Murray and C.J. Stroud for Week 7.
Listener mailbag questions address player evaluations and trade decisions involving key fantasy assets.
